title: rosa coriifolia var. cimbrica
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. cimbrica, commonly known as Cimbric Wild Rose or Sea Rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia var. cimbrica include its use as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, which may help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
